# @stackline/png-chunks-extract@1.0.3 on Alexandro.Net

- Canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/png-chunks-extract/
- Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-png-chunks-extract
- Upstream compatibility baseline: png-chunks-extract@1.0.0
- Runtime: Node.js 18 or newer and modern browser bundlers
- Module formats: callable CommonJS and native ESM default
- Types: TypeScript 3.9-compatible CommonJS and conditional modern declarations
- Production closure: one root node and zero dependencies
- License: MIT

Identity-preserving npm alias:

png-chunks-extract@npm:@stackline/png-chunks-extract@1.0.3

The package accepts Buffer and Uint8Array, returns detached Uint8Array chunk
payloads, proves the full chunk envelope before payload allocation, enforces
the 2^31 - 1 PNG length ceiling, and validates IEEE CRC-32 including IEND.
